gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-pt-sans: Shantell Sans has a wide, hand-cut mouth and a thick, glowing line, like neon tubing bent into letters. And PT Sans follows with lighter, friendly strokes and open arcs, so long paragraphs stay easy on the eye.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-quattrocento-san: Letters that look cut from strips of equal width give Shantell Sans its wobbly, playful charm. Quattrocento Sans then settles in with a modern, sans-serif tidiness, its gaps keeping each c distinct from an o as the text runs on.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-red-hat-text: Red Hat Text draws curvy, unclamped letters with the fine line of a technical drawing pen, so it feels modern and approachable. But Shantell Sans above it stays the loud one, wide-mouthed and hand-made, while the paragraphs below hum along quietly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans reads in a straightforward, professional way, its e opening wide at the terminal and its stroke thickness holding steady in every direction. Shantell Sans brings the handmade swagger above it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-rethink-sans: Shantell Sans is distinctive and expressive, with a wide mouth and a single fixed nib width throughout every letter it draws. Rethink Sans supplies the plain sans calm beneath it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-roboto-flex: Letters bent from a single length of wire make Shantell Sans instantly recognizable, and its wide, open mouth adds to the fun. Roboto Flex handles the reading, a modern sans-serif whose broad slot between the c's two ends keeps text easy going.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-rosario: Expressive and a little quirky, Shantell Sans joins stems and curves without any swelling, giving every heading a hand-drawn directness. Rosario's contemporary sans, with its c ends never turning inward, keeps things friendly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ruluko: Shantell Sans replaces thin hairline joins with full-width stroke connections. Ruluko is the plain sans underneath, and its broad open counters on c and s let you size the text up a touch for comfort.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sansation: Lines like a bent straw, shaped into letters, give Shantell Sans its bouncy, one-of-a-kind look. And Sansation, a neutral sans-serif with no ink pooling where curves turn inward, gives that energy somewhere smooth to land.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sarabun: Bouncy and handmade, Shantell Sans keeps a line width that never swells or tapers, wide mouth and all. Sarabun, a clean sans-serif, then opens a wide channel into every bowl, so the text feels approachable under all that character.
